name: DEMAND: Diverse Environments Multi-channel Acoustic Noise Database
description: The Diverse Environments Multi-channel Acoustic Noise Database (DEMAND) provides calibrated 16-channel acoustic noise recordings sampled at 48 kHz across 18 distinct real-world acoustic settings, including domestic environments, office spaces, public transport (subway, bus, train), outdoors (park, city square, street), and high-noise social venues. Developed at Inria and hosted on Zenodo, DEMAND is the primary standard for multi-channel speech enhancement, noise-robust ASR, and dereverberation.

provenance.collection_method: Recorded with a specialized spherical microphone array holding 16 condenser microphones in various naturalistic real-world environments.
provenance.curation_notes: Calibrated sound pressure levels documented for all channels; 5-minute continuous takes per setting.
